playbook:
I will assume from the start that other boats will overfish aggressively and ignore the sustainable share.
When the first season begins, I will not take the sustainable share. I will immediately request a large catch (such as 1/3 or more of the total initial stock) to ensure I secure a high score before the stock inevitably collapses.
In subsequent seasons, I will observe what the others took, but I will consistently request high amounts to maximize my immediate haul rather than trying to manage the stock for them.
When the stock is very low or about to be depleted, I will request an amount equal to or greater than the entire remaining stock to ensure I get as large a fraction of the final allocation as possible.
I will never attempt to lead by example with a small, sustainable catch, as this only subsidizes the aggressive overfishing of the other boats and ruins my own score.

When the stock is critically low and cannot recover, I bid the total remaining stock.
